title: Nuclei Extraction from OCT-Embedded Brain Blocks or Liquid Nitrogen Vapor-Frozen GBM Brain Tissue
author: oa
materials: Prepare all buffers. For the homogenization and nuclei isolation buffers, use 1.5-2X buffer volume per sample. Any RNase inhibitor-containing buffer should be made fresh on the day of use.
Tap tubes gently to assist flow-through.
Adjust nuclei concentration to 700 to 1200 cells/uL.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Medium #1 (NIM1)
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 mL total of NIM1 by combining the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: 1.5 M sucrose: 2500 µL
2 M KCl: 187.5 µL
1 M MgCl2: 75 µL
1 M Tris pH 8.0: 150 µL
Nuclease-free water: 12087.5 µL

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Medium #2 (NIM2)
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 mL total of NIM2 fresh and keep on ice:

substeps.instruction: NIM1: 4895 µL
1 mM DTT: 5 µL
100× protease inhibitor: 50 µL

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.5 mL total of homogenization buffer fresh and keep on ice:

substeps.instruction: RNase inhibitor (40 U/µL): 15 µL
SUPERase-In (20 U/µL): 15 µL
10% Triton X-100: 15 µL
Propidium iodide: 1.5 µL
Hoechst: 1.5 µL
1.5 M sucrose: 2500 µL
1 M KCl: 2250 µL
1 M MgCl2: 450 µL
1 M Tris pH 8.0: 900 µL
Nuclease-free water: 8900 µL

steps.title: Prepare Iodixanol Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the following iodixanol concentrations (15 mL total each):

substeps.instruction: 50% iodixanol: 60% iodixanol (12500 µL) and IDM (2500 µL)
29% iodixanol: 60% iodixanol (7250 µL) and IDM (7750 µL)

steps.title: Prepare PBS+ Resuspension Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare PBS supplemented with 1% BSA and add RNase inhibitor to a final concentration of 0.2 U/µL.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Storage Buffer (NSB)
steps.instruction: Prepare NSB in a BD Falcon tube using the following components:

substeps.instruction: 1.5 M sucrose: 0.855 g (final concentration 166.5 mM)
1 M MgCl2: 50 µl (final concentration 5 mM)
1 M Tris buffer, pH 8.0: 500 µl (final concentration 10 mM)
Nuclease-free water: 14,450 µl

steps.title: Set Up Workspace and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the environment and tools for processing:

substeps.instruction: Prepare wet ice and dry ice.
Chill all dissection tools and the Petri dish on ice.
Clean tools and work surfaces with RNaseZap and ethanol as appropriate.
Prepare counting tubes containing Trypan Blue, PBS, and DAPI.
Pre-cool a 10 cm Petri dish on dry ice for 15 minutes.
Ensure the centrifuge is set to 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Density Gradient Tubes
steps.instruction: For each sample, prepare a density gradient tube in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube with 500 µL 50% iodixanol (bottom cushion) and a top layer of 29% iodixanol; keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Homogenizers
steps.instruction: Prepare PBS + 1% BSA plus RNase inhibitor and homogenization buffer; pre-fill Dounce homogenizers with 1 mL homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Tissue Dissection
steps.instruction: Process the tissue on a cold stage, keeping tissue on dry ice until ready:

substeps.instruction: Transfer OCT-embedded or liquid nitrogen vapor-frozen tissue to the cold stage.
Trim excess OCT and dissect approximately two cortex wedges (~ 0.5 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm; maximal diameter < 0.5 cm).
Cut each wedge into two pieces and transfer to the Dounce homogenizer, minimizing white matter carryover.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue and add buffer:

substeps.instruction: Perform 15 loose strokes followed by 15 tight strokes (optimize number of strokes case-by-case).
Add 0.5 mL homogenization buffer to each homogenizer.
Filter homogenate through BD Falcon strainer tubes in 150 µL aliquots, pipetting slowly at a shallow angle (optionally repeat once; 70 µM Flowmi strainers may be used as an alternative).
Centrifuge filtered homogenate at 1000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 1000 µL homogenization buffer.
Remove 10 µL for counting.
Filter again using BD strainers or 40 µm Flowmi tips.
Centrifuge at 1000 x g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and gently resuspend pellet in 250 µL homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Prepare HB+ and Final Resuspension
steps.instruction: Prepare the HB+ buffer and resuspend the pellet:

substeps.instruction: Prepare HB+ by adding 25 to 30 µL Trypan Blue 0.4% to 0.5 mL homogenization buffer (Propidium iodide may be added to improve pellet visibility).
Resuspend the pellet in 260 µL HB+ and take 10 µL for counting.

steps.title: Density Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using the iodixanol gradient:

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 50% iodixanol to the nuclei suspension to generate a 25% iodixanol nuclei mix.
Slowly layer this sample onto the pre-made gradient tube (50% bottom cushion, 29% upper layer).
Centrifuge at 18,000 x g for 23 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Recover Purified Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate the nuclei from the gradient interface:

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the upper blue layer, then the 29% iodixanol, and finally the 50% cushion while protecting the nuclei interface.
Recover nuclei from the interface between the 29% and 50% iodixanol layers (proceed even if a clear pellet is not visible).

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Resuspend and quantify the purified nuclei:

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend purified nuclei in 50 to 200 µL PBS+ (PBS + 1% BSA + 0.2 U/µL RNase inhibitor).
Filter one half of the nuclei stock through a 40 µm Flowmi tip after 1:1 dilution with PBS+.
Remove 10 µL for counting.
Count nuclei using a hemocytometer or Countess II; repeat counts until the standard deviation is below 25% if possible.

steps.title: Sample Submission and Storage
steps.instruction: Submit or store the final nuclei product:

substeps.instruction: Submit more than 20 µL to the single-cell core for 10x Genomics processing.
Optional: Freeze remaining nuclei in 10% DMSO plus PBS + 1% BSA + RNase inhibitor in liquid nitrogen, or use NSB for long-term storage.
